sentences.english_text: In Russia, just outside Moscow, all the Russian generals were in their war room, studying their computers.
One of the Russian generals exclaimed, Luke, there are American water planes heading this way.
It was unbelievable.
The Americans have declared war on us.
And they rushed to study the other computers.
But all the computers told them the same thing.
In a few minutes, Russia was going to be attacked.
The head of the Russian army said, We must send our war missiles against them immediately.
The other generals nodded their heads.
This means the end of the world.
But we cannot let the Americans destroy Russia.
Go ahead, do it.
The general picked up the telephone and said, The Americans are attacking us.
Send up our planes.
We are going to bomb New York and Chicago and Los Angeles.
And he replaced the receiver.
This means World War III.
World War III.
And who was it who had started all this?
Trippie.
He was having the greatest adventure of his life.
And he was not even aware of it.
He slept through the whole thing.
All around him, majors and colonels and generals were racing about the room, shouting orders and getting ready for the attack.
There was a hotline to Moscow.
A general said, Mr. President, don't you think you should pick up the phone and talk to Russia?
Maybe it's not too late to stop them.
You're right.
We must try to do everything we can to prevent this.
The president picked up the red phone, and it was immediately answered by a Russian general.
Why are you attacking us?
The president asked.
Because you're attacking us, the Russian general replied.
But you attacked us first.
We did nothing of the kind.
Our computers show that your planes are on their way to bomb us.
Our computers show that your planes were on their way first.
That's not true.
We don't want World War III, the president of the United States exclaimed.
Neither do we.
If you turn your planes back, the Russian general promised, we'll turn ours back.
Oh, no, the president of the United States said.
You turn yours back first, and then we'll turn ours back.
They did not trust each other.
It's no deal, the Russian general said.
The president looked at a huge map on the wall showing where the airplanes were.
A general hurried to his side.
Mr. President, in two minutes, it's going to be too late for our planes to turn back.
We're going to have to go ahead and bomb Russia.
Those are the Russian planes.
In two minutes, they're going to be bombing the United States.
What are we going to do?
The president shook his head sadly.
There is nothing we can do.
In two minutes, we're going to be at war.
It will be the end of the world.
